recalls.defect: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2013 Acura RDX, ILX, 2012-2013 Honda CR-V, Civic, and 2013 Accord vehicles equipped with certain Takata front and passenger air bag inflators. The inflators may rupture due to propellant degradation occurring after long-term exposure to high absolute humidity and high temperature variation.
recalls.consequence: An inflator rupture may result in sharp metal fragments striking the driver or other occupants resulting in serious injury or death.
recalls.remedy: Dealers will replace the front driver or passenger air bag inflator, free of charge. Interim letters notifying owners of the safety risk are expected to be mailed December 18, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the final remedy is available. Owners may contact Honda's customer service at 1-888-234-2138. Honda's numbers for this recall are BQK, MQJ, KQI, and QQH. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning November 22, 2026.

recalls.defect: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Ram 1500 Classic pickup trucks. The anti-lock brake (ABS) module software may misread inputs from the brake pedal and pedal sensor, which can result in improper brake light illumination, unintentional vehicle movement, or a loss of driver assist features, such as electronic stability control, AutoPark, and forward collision warning.
recalls.consequence: Improper brake light illumination, unintentional vehicle movement, and a loss of driver assist features, such as electronic stability control, AutoPark, and forward collision warning, can increase the risk of a crash.
recalls.remedy: Dealers will update the ABS module software, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed January 14, 2027. Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 800-853-1403. Chrysler's number for this recall is A9D. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning November 26, 2026.

recalls.component: ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING:ENGINE:HARD PARTS INTERNAL/MECHANICAL
recalls.defect: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2022-2023 and 2025-2026 Tundra vehicles. One of the engine camshafts may have been manufactured incorrectly, allowing cracks to develop that can cause the camshaft to snap, possibly leading to an engine stall and loss of drive power.
recalls.consequence: A loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash.
recalls.remedy: Dealers will inspect and replace the camshaft as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed beginning December 28, 2026. Owners may contact Toyota's customer service at 1-800-331-4331. Toyota's numbers for this recall are 26TB26 and 26TA26.

recalls.defect: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2002-2010 Lexus SC430, 2011 IS250, 2017 GX460, 2003-2008 Toyota Corolla, 2005-2006 Tundra, 2005-2007 Sequoia, and 2016-2017 4Runner vehicles equipped with certain Takata front passenger air bag inflators installed as original equipment or as replacement parts under a prior recall. The inflators may rupture due to propellant degradation occurring after long-term exposure to high absolute humidity, high temperatures, and high temperature cycling.
recalls.consequence: An inflator rupture may result in sharp metal fragments striking the driver or other occupants resulting in serious injury or death.
recalls.remedy: Depending on the vehicle model, dealers will replace the front passenger air bag inflator or the air bag assembly, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed beginning December 28, 2026. Owners may contact Toyota's customer service at 1-800-331-4331. Toyota's numbers for this recall are 26TB25, 26TA25, 26LB11, and 26LA11.

recalls.defect: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2026 Transit vehicles. A software error in the body control module C (BCMC) may cause the module to freeze, shutting off certain features such as interior lighting and trailer lights. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
recalls.consequence: A loss of lighting can reduce trailer visibility to other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash.
recalls.remedy: The body control module C (BCMC) software will be updated by a dealer, or through an over-the-air (OTA) update, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 12, 2026. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 26C49. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on November 6, 2026.

recalls.defect: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2012-2016 3 Series, 5 Series, Z4, 2012-2015 X1, 2013-2017 X3, 2015-2016 4 Series Gran Coupe, 2 Series Convertible, 2014-2016 328xi Gran Turismo, 2 Series Coupe, 4 Series Convertible, 3 Series Coupe, 3 Series Sportswagon, 2015-2018 X4, and 2016-2018 X5 xDrive40e vehicles. An improperly sealed electrical connector on the water pump may be exposed to water and short circuit.
recalls.consequence: A short circuit increases the risk of a fire.
recalls.remedy: Owners are advised to park their vehicles outside and away from structures until the recall remedy is completed. The remedy is currently under development. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed in December 2026. Owners may contact BMW customer service at 1-800-525-7417. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning December 25, 2026. This recall replaces NHTSA recall number 24V608. Vehicles already repaired under the previous recall will need to have the new remedy completed.

recalls.defect: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2021-2025 Acura TLX, 2022-2024 Acura MDX, and 2023-2025 Pilot vehicles. The software for the electric power steering (EPS) assist may cause the EPS system to enter a failsafe mode, resulting in a loss of power steering assist.
recalls.consequence: A loss of power steering assist can increase the risk of a crash or injury.
recalls.remedy: Dealers will reprogram the EPS control unit, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 14, 2026. Owners may contact Honda's customer service at 1-866-784-1870. Honda's numbers for this recall are KQB and TQA. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning November 11, 2026.

recalls.component: SERVICE BRAKES, HYDRAULIC:ANTILOCK/TRACTION CONTROL/ELECTRONIC LIMITED SLIP:CONTROL UNIT/MODULE
recalls.defect: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2023â2027 Cadillac LYRIQ, 2025â2026 model year Cadillac CELESTIQ, 2024â2027 Chevrolet Blazer EV, and 2026-2027 Cadillac VISTIQ vehicles. The brake system control module (BSCM) contains a software defect that may cause a loss of braking during certain driving conditions.
recalls.consequence: A loss of braking ability increases the risk of a crash.
recalls.remedy: The BSCM software will be updated through an over-the-air (OTA) update or by a dealer, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 14, 2026. Owners may contact Cadillac customer service at 1-800-333-4223 or Chevrolet customer service at 1-800-222-1020. GM's number for this recall is N262570900. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 29, 2026.

recalls.component: FUEL SYSTEM, DIESEL:DELIVERY:HOSES, LINES/PIPING, AND FITTINGS
recalls.defect: Battle Motors, Inc. (Battle Motors) is recalling certain 2021-2023 Crane Carrier LET2 and LNT vehicles. The remote fuel filter hoses may separate from the fitting, causing a fuel leak and an engine stall.
recalls.consequence: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a fire. An engine stall increases the risk of a crash.
recalls.remedy: Cummins will replace the fuel hoses, free of charge. Owners may contact Cummins' customer service at 1-800-286-6467. Battle Motors' number for this recall is Cummins C7311.

recalls.defect: BMW of North America, LLC is recalling certain 2018 740Le xDrive, 2018-2020 530e iPerformance, and 2018-2020 530e xDrive vehicles. The postive battery cable on the engine starter may loosen.
recalls.consequence: A loose positive battery cable can create sparking, increasing the risk of a fire.
recalls.remedy: Dealers will inspect and, if necessary, replace the engine starter, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 11, 2026. Owners may contact BMW customer service at 1-800-525-7417. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning December 11, 2026. Vehicles in this recall were previously repaired under recall 26V441.

recalls.defect: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2022-2026 Sienna Hybrid  7-passenger vehicles. The second-row seat backs may fail to remain secured in the event of a crash.
recalls.consequence: A seat back that is not secured may fail to properly protect an occupant during a crash, increasing the risk of injury.
recalls.remedy: Dealers will update the supplemental restraint system (SRS) electronic control unit (ECU) software. For vehicles equipped with the "Mobility as a Service" (MaaS) package, dealers will replace the two second-row seat backs. Repairs will be performed free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 7, 2026. Owners may contact Toyota's customer service at 1-800-331-4331. Toyota's numbers for this recall are 26TB24 and 26TA24.

recalls.defect: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Audi) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Q4 E-Tron and Q4 Sportback E-Tron vehicles. The high voltage battery may fail and cause a fire.
recalls.consequence: A vehicle fire increases the risk of injury.
recalls.remedy: Owners are advised to only charge their vehicles to a maximum of 80% capacity until the repair has been completed. The remedy is currently under development. Interim letters notifying owners of the safety risk are expected to be mailed December 18, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the remedy is available. Owners may contact Audi customer service at 1-800-253-2834. Audi's number for this recall is 93SK. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 23, 2026.

recalls.defect: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Lexus  NX250, NX350, NX350 Hybrid, and NX450h+ vehicles. The instrument panel cluster combination meter may fail to display certain warnings or indicators. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 101, "Control and Displays."
recalls.consequence: An instrument panel display that fails to show engine oil pressure, engine coolant temperature, or electrical charge increases the risk of a crash.
recalls.remedy: Dealers will update the combination meter software, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 7, 2026. Owners may contact Toyota's customer service at 1-800-331-4331. Toyota's number for this recall is 26LA10.

recalls.component: BACK OVER PREVENTION: SENSING SYSTEM: CAMERA
recalls.manufacturer: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC
recalls.defect: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Land Rover) is recalling certain 2022-2026 Land Rover Range Rover vehicles. Water may not be able to drain away from the rearview camera due to insufficient drain holes, which may result in damage to the rearview camera.
recalls.consequence: A rearview camera image that does not display can reduce the driver's view behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
recalls.remedy: Dealers will drill additional drain holes in the underside of the tailgate trim. Additionally, dealers will inspect and replace the rearview camera as necessary. Repairs will be performed free of charge. Interim letters notifying owners of the safety risk are expected to be mailed December 11, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the final remedy is available. Owners may contact Land Rover's customer service at 800-637-6837. Land Rover's number for this recall is D171.

recalls.defect: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2023-2026 ID.4 vehicles. The high voltage battery may fail and lead to a vehicle fire.
recalls.consequence: A vehicle fire increases the risk of injury.
recalls.remedy: Owners are advised to only charge their vehicles to a maximum of 80% battery capacity until the repair has been completed. The remedy is currently under development. Interim letters, notifying owners of the safety risk, are expected to be mailed November 27, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the remedy is available. Owners may contact Volkswagen customer service at 1-800-893-5298. Volkswagen's number for this recall is 93EX. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 6, 2026.

recalls.defect: Subaru of America, Inc. (Subaru) is recalling certain 2026 Crosstrek and Forester vehicles. The castle nut on the left-front lower control arm ball joint may be improperly fastened, which can lead to the ball joint separating from the lower control arm.
recalls.consequence: A ball joint that separates from the lower control arm can cause a loss of vehicle control, increasing the risk of a crash.
recalls.remedy: Owners are advised not to drive their vehicle until the remedy is completed. Dealers will inspect and replace the left-front lower control arm ball joint assembly, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 16, 2026.  Owners may contact Subaru customer service at 1-844-373-6614.  Subaru's number for this recall is WRI26.

recalls.defect: Porsche Cars North America, Inc. (Porsche) is recalling certain 2024 718 Cayman GT4 RS, 911 Turbo S, 911 Turbo, 911 S/T, 911 GT3 RS, 911 GT3, 911 Carrera GTS, and 718 Spyder RS vehicles. The center lock wheel bolt may fracture and cause the wheel to detach.
recalls.consequence: Wheel detachment can result in a loss of vehicle control, increasing the risk of a crash.
recalls.remedy: Owners are advised not to drive their vehicles until they have been repaired. Dealers will check the center lock wheel fastening system and replace any incorrectly manufactured parts, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 15, 2026. Owners may contact Porsche customer service at 1-800-767-7243. Porsche's number for this recall is ATA1. This recall expands previous NHTSA recall number 24V809. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 20, 2026.

recalls.defect: Hyundai Motor America (Genesis) is recalling certain 2015-2016 Hyundai Genesis, and 2017-2020 Genesis G80 vehicles. The front power seat motors may overheat due to a stuck power seat control switch, which can result in a fire while parked or driving.
recalls.consequence: A fire increases the risk of injury.
recalls.remedy: Owners are advised to park their vehicles outdoors and away from other vehicles or structures until the repair has been performed. The remedy is currently under development. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 7, 2026. Owners of Hyundai vehicles may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460. Genesis owners may contact Genesis customer service at 844-340-9741. Hyundai recall number for this recall is 308 and Genesis' recall number is 035G. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning October 13, 2026.

recalls.component: FUEL SYSTEM, GASOLINE:DELIVERY:HOSES, LINES/PIPING, AND FITTINGS
recalls.defect: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2024-2027 Toyota Land Cruiser Hybrid vehicles. The fuel tube connection near the fuel tank may disconnect and leak fuel.
recalls.consequence: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source can increase the risk of a fire.
recalls.remedy: Dealers will inspect the connection and install a supplemental clamp or, as necessary, replace the resin fuel tube and install a supplemental clamp, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 29, 2026. Owners may contact Toyota's customer service at 1-800-331-4331. Toyota's numbers for this recall are 26TB23 and 26TA23.

recalls.defect: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2022-2026 Ram 1500 Promaster, Ram 2500 Promaster, Ram 3500 Promaster, and 2024-2026 Ram 3500 Electric (EV) vehicles. Water may enter the electric power steering wiring harness, which can disable power steering assist.
recalls.consequence: A loss of power steering assist can increase the risk of a crash.
recalls.remedy: Dealers will inspect and replace the wiring harness and electronic power steering gear, as necessary, free of charge. Interim notification letters, notifying owners of the safety risk, are expected to be mailed November 17, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the final remedy is available. Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 800-853-1403. Chrysler's number for this recall is 92D. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 6, 2026.

recalls.defect: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025-2026 F-250 SD, F-350 SD, F-450 SD, F-550 SD, F-600, 2026 F-150, and F-750 SD vehicles. The analog clusterâs tachometer and speedometer may become stuck or move erratically, providing inaccurate readings to the driver. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) Number 101, "Controls and Displays."
recalls.consequence: A speedometer that fails to display accurate vehicle speed can increase the risk of a crash.
recalls.remedy: Dealers will replace the instrument cluster modules, free of charge. Interim letters, notifying owners of the safety risk, are expected to be mailed in October 26, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the remedy is available, anticipated in December 2026. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 26C46. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 7, 2026.
